page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; margin notes on the right side (three notes: beside lines 9, 14 and 20); catchword and gathering signature at the foot; running head at the top.

main_text.p: ac rerum sacratarum curam gerebant, rationes æditimorum[?] examinabant, fœne-ratores comprimebant, pœnas ab iis poscebant. Præter hos Officialis quoque & Officialis & Com-missarius. Commissarius, uti vocabant, in cura-tione rerum talium pro Episcopo erant: sed in populo libero tantum non poterant, quantum fere aliis in regionibus solent. Quæ omnia durarunt, quandiu regnum Pontificium cum imperio Hi-spanico hic stetit: eo vero finito, hæc quoque interiere. Quibus quæ succesfere clas-sibus congregandis, & habendis synodis, ut verbo divino & primævæ Ecclesiæ propiora, sic usu quoque ipso, si pietas modo in utentibus fit, sine dubio meliora.

Sacerdotes in agro numerati olim su-Sacerdotum numerus olim in Agro.pra cc. xx, quantulo in spatio? præter tot monachos & monachas, quot capi tam multis, & quidem peramplis ac opulentis cœnobiis potuêre: quorum numerus fide multo major fuit.
Populus universus cum reliquis Frisiis Populi libertas.à temporibus Caroli Magni ad Saxonum arma per annos fere DCC liber fuit, fuiqne[?] juris, Domini nescius: summi principis

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "æditimorum" (probably ædituorum, the second letter is unclear); "fuiqne" (the abbreviation may be fuisque, marked as read). Text in the margin is set in italic, shown as plain text in the notes. No printing errors were corrected. The scan shows a Google watermark at the bottom right, which was left out.
